notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q12495_burj_khalifa.py, tools/meshkit.py) with AI assistance. The Y-shaped «Hymenocallis» plan is parametric: three wings at 120° (straight arms 18–25 m wide with rounded, slightly pointed ends) round a hexagonal core, and three core lobes between the wings; their outline is the exact union of these convex lobes. The wings step back in a clockwise spiral at the heights of the OpenStreetMap building:parts (35, 70, 105, 130, 160, 200, 235, 270, 315, 360, 405, 460, 520, 605, 625, 645, 710 m), then the core lobes (545, 560, 580, 660, 680, 700, 720, 740, 760 m) — 28 tiers, close to the 27 setbacks of the published figures — and a tapering steel spire rises from 760 m to 828 m (tip 829.8 m). Silver-blue reflective glass (GLASS) with the stainless vertical fins as light stripes every 1.6 m; darker bands for the mechanical floors and the observation levels (floors 124–125 at 452 m, 148 at 555 m); light grey setback terraces; above the top floor (585.4 m) the crown tiers and the spire are METAL. The low podium pavilions round the foot (15 m) follow the OSM parts. Heading 185.7° = the south wing, towards the Burj Khalifa Lake, the Dubai Fountain and the Dubai Mall; origin on the axis of the spire. Not modelled: the lake, the fountain and the reflecting pools of the park (80–300 m away, left to the map), the Dubai Mall, the window-cleaning machines, the floor-by-floor spandrels. Uncertain: the OSM setback heights are round figures (±5 m); the last tier of the south and north-west wings (to 710 m) is assumed like the north-east one; the widths and end shapes of the wings are fitted to the OSM crescents (±1 m); the heights of the mechanical bands are interpolated from the floor count (±3 m); the diameter of the spire (5 m at its foot) is an estimate (±30 %); the podium height (15 m) is the OSM figure.
